# A blog for your AI | Rho Lall

> Rho Lall is a BI Architect in Phoenix, AZ. He writes posts meant to be handed
> to an AI assistant, and works with founder-led ecommerce and lifestyle brands
> to untangle accumulated data, reporting, and business logic.
